definition: An intermediate, platform-independent representation of Python source code generated by CPython and executed by the Python Virtual Machine.
Read-Eval-Print Loop: an interactive Python shell prompt (>>>) that reads one statement, evaluates it, prints the result, and repeats.
A typing discipline where types are associated with runtime values rather than fixed variable declarations in source code.
A report printed by Python when an unhandled exception occurs, showing the call stack and line numbers leading to the error.
A port of CPython to WebAssembly that runs Python and scientific packages directly inside a web browser.
